units.source_text: 尽管是平日，但时值观光季节，当天金阁的游客甚众，简直是人山人海。

en.t: Although it was a weekday, it was the sightseeing season, and the Golden Pavilion was so crowded with visitors that day that it was simply a sea of people.

units.source_text: 导游老人惊异地望着穿过人群急匆匆地跑到全阁前的我。

en.t: The elderly guide stared in astonishment at me as I hurried through the crowd and ran up in front of the Golden Pavilion.
